per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be easy to use such that 95% of adjusters and estimators report that it is easy to use in post-deployment surveys.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Parts search operations shall appear responsive to users; recycled parts search results must return within 15 seconds or less under typical conditions, with preference for much faster responses.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Repair facility lookup (location-based) shall return results within 8 seconds or less under typical conditions, with faster responses preferred.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall achieve at least 98% availability over a year (high nineties uptime), with minimal downtime during peak business hours.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support approximately 1,500 concurrent users at peak without degraded responsiveness.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Each insurer (tenant) shall only be able to view their own claims and related data; no cross-tenant data visibility is permitted.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall implement role-based access control so that users have appropriate permissions (e.g., read-only vs full edit) mapped to business roles.
The system shall include protections against denial-of-service attacks and automated scraping of parts data to preserve availability and partner trust.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The product must meet corporate security expectations from day one; security controls cannot be added post-launch without InfoSec and Ops involvement.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Aggregated, anonymized repair-facility performance indicators may be displayed broadly, but individual notes tied to a claim must be restricted to the insurer or to specific roles and not exported widely.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide mechanisms to capture repair shop feedback without encouraging low-quality or inflammatory comments (e.g., moderation, structured inputs, or quality controls).
The system shall provide a resilient experience for field staff by supporting basic lookups and a recent cache while offline; full offline claim editing is not required initially.
Parts data must originate from the Choice Parts feed and the system shall not introduce duplicate master copies of that data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Parts data shall be updated frequently (near-real-time preferred) so that listings reflect current availability and adjusters can trust availability information.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall follow corporate UI look-and-feel and architecture guidelines to ensure trust, supportability, and consistent user experience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Monitoring, audit trails, and traceability shall be provided to show who changed what for internal reviews and compliance.
The system shall be practical to deploy and support operationally; it must not require a specialized operations team.
The product team shall involve Ops and InfoSec during design and before launch to meet corporate security expectations and operational readiness.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall include measures to detect and prevent malicious or accidental overloads (e.g., DDoS detection/mitigation and rate limiting) to protect business continuity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall include periodic post-launch usability checks to detect regressions in usability over time.
The system shall minimize printed outputs as an outcome, supporting reduced paper use (sustainability objective).
The system shall provide anonymized, aggregated partner reputation signals while preventing punitive exposure of individual incidents without context.
